IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO SAVE LIVES AND REDUCE SUFFERING BY EDUCATING THE PUBLIC (CONTINUED ON SCHED O) (CONTINUED FROM PG 1, PART 1, LINE 1) AND LEADING AN ALLIANCE OF PATIENTS, HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS, AND PARTNERS COMMITTED TO PREVENTING AND CURING SEPSIS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: TO SAVE LIVES AND REDUCE SUFFERING BY EDUCATING THE PUBLIC AND LEADING AN ALLIANCE OF PATIENTS, HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS, AND PARTNERS COMMITTED TO PREVENTING AND CURING SEPSIS.
IRS990.Desc: PUBLIC AWARENESS AND EDUCATIONSEPSIS ALLIANCE CONTINUED TO EXPAND ITS REACH THROUGH SEPSIS.ORG, WHICH SERVED OVER 2 MILLION VISITORS WITH UPDATED AND MULTILINGUAL RESOURCES. THE ORGANIZATION LAUNCHED SEVERAL TARGETED CAMPAIGNS, INCLUDING THE PARTNERSHIP FOR SEPSIS AND AGING (TPSA) IN COLLABORATION WITH THE NEW YORK STATE DEPARTMENT OF AGING, AND A PCORI-FUNDED PROJECT TO TRAIN SURVIVORS AND HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS IN RESEARCH DESIGN. ADDITIONAL CAMPAIGNS ADDRESSED INFECTION PREVENTION IN HOME CARE, FLU AWARENESS IN ELDER CARE, AND SEPSIS EDUCATION IN SCHOOLS AND AMONG ATHLETES.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION AND TRAININGTHE SEPSIS ALLIANCE INSTITUTE (SAI) EXPERIENCED A 33.6% INCREASE IN USERS, REACHING OVER 55,000 LEARNERS. IT DELIVERED MORE THAN 117,000 RN CONTINUING EDUCATION CREDITS AND ADDED 30 NEW COURSES. THE ORGANIZATION HOSTED MULTIPLE HIGH-IMPACT EVENTS, INCLUDING THE SEPSIS ALLIANCE AMR CONFERENCE, NTI EXPO HALL ACTIVITIES, AND SYMPOSIA ON MATERNAL/NEONATAL AND IMMUNOCOMPROMISED PATIENT SEPSIS. THE FIFTH ANNUAL SEPSIS ALLIANCE SUMMIT DREW OVER 3,000 REGISTRANTS. PEER-TO-PEER ENGAGEMENT ALSO SURGED, WITH A 276% INCREASE IN DISCUSSION RESPONSES AND A 115% INCREASE IN RESOURCE DOWNLOADS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: POLICY AND ADVOCACYSEPSIS ALLIANCE ACHIEVED MAJOR LEGISLATIVE MILESTONES IN 2024. THE ORGANIZATION CO-INTRODUCED LULU'S LAW IN THE U.S. HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES AND SUPPORTED THE PASSAGE OF LOCHLIN'S LAW IN MARYLAND. IT ACTIVATED OVER 1,500 GRASSROOTS ADVOCACY ACTIONS AND SECURED 38 STATE PROCLAMATIONS FOR SEPSIS AWARENESS MONTH. THE ORGANIZATION ALSO INFLUENCED NATIONAL POLICY THROUGH PARTICIPATION IN AMR COALITIONS, ADVOCACY TRAINING WEBINARS, AND MEDIA PLACEMENTS IN OUTLETS SUCH AS NBC, FOX NEWS, AND READER'S DIGEST. NOTABLY, SEPSIS ALLIANCE CONTRIBUTED TO THE AUTHORIZATION OF A NEW ICD-10 CODE FOR SEPSIS AFTERCARE AND SUPPORTED THE CDC'S ROLLOUT OF THE SEPSIS CORE ELEMENTS PROGRAM.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: SURVIVOR AND CAREGIVER SUPPORTSEPSIS ALLIANCE CONNECT CELEBRATED ITS SECOND ANNIVERSARY, GROWING TO OVER 2,100 MEMBERS AND OFFERING MORE THAN 120 PEER SUPPORT SESSIONS AND 15 NEW ON-DEMAND EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS. THE PLATFORM INTRODUCED AFFINITY GROUPS FOR YOUNG ADULTS AND AMPUTEE SURVIVORS AND EXPANDED ITS EDUCATIONAL AND RESOURCE OFFERINGS TO BETTER SUPPORT THOSE AFFECTED BY SEPSIS.RESEARCH AND INNOVATIONTHROUGH ITS INFECTION MANAGEMENT/SEPSIS COLLABORATIVE COMMUNITY (IMSCC), FUNDED BY THE ADMINISTRATION FOR STRATEGIC PREPAREDNESS AND RESPONSE (ASPR), SEPSIS ALLIANCE COMPLETED TWO MAJOR RESEARCH PROJECTS. THESE INCLUDED A PATIENT EXPERIENCE SURVEY AND A REGULATORY FRAMEWORK FOR SEPSIS-RELATED MEDICAL DEVICES, BOTH SUBMITTED FOR PEER-REVIEWED PUBLICATION. THESE INITIATIVES UNDERSCORE THE ORGANIZATION'S GROWING ROLE AS A CONVENER AND THOUGHT LEADER IN SEPSIS INNOVATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: LOBBYING ACTIVITIES: TO SERVE AS THE LEADING SEPSIS ADVOCACY ORGANIZATION AND TRUSTED EXPERT ON LEGISLATION AND PUBLIC POLICY THAT IMPROVES SEPSIS AWARENESS, EDUCATION, DIAGNOSIS, TREATMENT, AND SURVIVOR CARE. TO EDUCATE POLICYMAKERS, ADVOCATES, HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS, AND THE GENERAL PUBLIC ABOUT LEGISLATION, REGULATIONS, AND PUBLIC POLICIES THAT DIRECTLY IMPACT SEPSIS PATIENTS, SURVIVORS, AND LOVED ONES INCLUDING: THE NEED FOR BETTER CONNECTED SEPSIS DATA ON THE STATE AND FEDERAL LEVELS THE IMPACT OF ANTIMICROBIAL RESISTANCE ON SEPSIS AND THEIR RELATIONSHIP SEPSIS MANAGEMENT AND TREATMENT GUIDANCE AS STIPULATED BY FEDERAL REGULATORY AND CARE REIMBURSEMENT ENTITIES.

THE ORGANIZATION IS SUBJECT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING STANDARDS BOARD'S (THE "FASB") ACCOUNTING STANDARDS CODIFICATION ("ASC") TOPIC 740, INCOME TAXES, AS IT RELATES TO ACCOUNTING AND REPORTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAXES. FOR THE ORGANIZATION, THESE PROVISIONS COULD BE APPLICABLE TO THE INCURRENCE OF UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME TAX ("UBIT") ON MERCHANDISE SALES. SINCE THE ORGANIZATION HAS ALWAYS RECORDED ANY POTENTIAL TAX AND DUE TO ITS GENERAL NOT-FOR-PROFIT STATUS, MANAGEMENT BELIEVES, ASC 740 HAS NOT HAD, AND IS NOT ANTICIPATED TO HAVE, A MATERIAL IMPACT ON THE ORGANIZATION'S FINANCIAL STATEMENTS. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES BENEFITS FROM UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS TAKEN IN ITS INCOME TAX RETURNS WHEN THOSE TAX POSITIONS ARE MORE THAN LIKELY NOT TO BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES. THERE ARE NO UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS, INTEREST OR PENALTIES INCLUDED IN THE STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION OR STATEMENT OF ACTIVITIES.
EMPLOYEES ARE ELIGIBLE TO RECEIVE EACH CALENDAR YEAR A PERFORMANCE-BASED BONUS AS DETERMINED BY THE BOARD BASED ON THE ACHIEVEMENT OF ESTABLISHED GOALS OF THE ORGANIZATION.
